datasets.name: yazi

from cm_active_credits p,avalute v,cm_curr_state h

datasets.name: BoorowerInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   bi.NAME,
   cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(a.booroweraccid) as custaccno,
   cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(a.Loanaccid) as loanaccno  
FROM
  CM_BOOROWERINFO bi, cm_accounts a
WHERE bi.CreditID=:CREDITID
and a.creditid = :CREDITID

datasets.name: CreditInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   A.ID , A.CURRENCY , A.CREDITLINEAMOUNT , A.ANNUALYINTERESTRATE , A.DATEOFCONCLUSION
 , A.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT , 
   A.CREDITTYPE,a.branchid,
   TRUNC (MONTHS_BETWEEN (A.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT ,A.DATEOFCONCLUSION)) as period,v.val_name,
   c.rest
FROM
   CM_ACTIVE_CREDITS A,avalute v,
   cm_curr_state c
WHERE a.ID=:ID
and c.creditid = :ID
and a.currency=v.valute

datasets.name: ScheduleData
datasets.sql:
SELECT Z.RowID,Z.*
  FROM CM_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE Z
WHERE Z.CREDITID=:CREDITID
ORDER BY PAYMENTDATE
